perplexity.description:
Waves Of Distortion (The Best Of Shoegaze 1990–2022) is a comprehensive two-disc compilation released by Two Piers in 2023, serving as a definitive overview of the shoegaze genre across more than three decades. The album features a curated selection of tracks from seminal acts such as Slowdive, Ride, Lush, and Chapterhouse, alongside rarities from bands like The Telescopes, highlighting the genre’s evolution from its early 1990s origins to its contemporary revival. Musically, the compilation showcases the hallmarks of shoegaze: lush layers of distorted guitar, ethereal vocals, and immersive soundscapes, making it an essential introduction for newcomers and a rewarding listen for longtime fans.

As a compilation by Various Artists, Waves Of Distortion does not fit within a single artist’s discography but stands as a landmark release for Two Piers, a label dedicated to reissues and genre-defining collections. The album’s broad chronological scope and inclusion of both classic and lesser-known tracks have been praised for its thoughtful curation and historical significance. Upon release, it received positive attention for its role in contextualizing shoegaze’s enduring influence, with critics noting its value as both a retrospective and a celebration of the genre’s ongoing vitality.
